company_type: IIT Madras spinoff, industrial AI/IoT for asset inspection

technology.technology_name: PRAcIS — Permanently Installed Acoustic Inspection Sensor (Industrial IIoT) + T-Pulse AI for industrial assets
technology.description: Detect Technologies, spun out of IIT Madras (originally a tech development between Reliance Industries and IIT Madras), develops IoT acoustic sensors and AI software to inspect industrial assets — gas tanks, reactors, boilers, furnaces, pipe racks — without requiring scaffolding or manual visual inspection. Aim: act as a 'central nervous system for all pipelines across any industry'.
technology.problem_solved: Traditional industrial inspection requires scaffolding + downtime + skilled inspectors. Detect's sensors enable continuous monitoring at a fraction of the cost and zero downtime.
technology.innovation_summary: Acoustic emission + AI analytics combined for industrial assets; cost-engineered for Indian operations; deployed at Reliance Industries (its early customer/co-developer).
technology.unique_selling_points: IIT Madras pedigree; Reliance as anchor customer; cost-engineered AI platform
technology.application_area: Refineries, petrochemical plants, oil & gas pipelines, power plants, fertilizer plants
technology.target_industries: Oil & gas, petrochemicals, power, fertilizers, large process industries
technology.potential_customers: IOC, BPCL, HPCL, GAIL, Reliance (existing), ONGC, NTPC
technology.patent_status: Multiple filings on sensor design + AI analytics
technology.estimated_market_size: Indian industrial inspection services: ₹5,000+ Cr; global IIoT inspection ~$10B
technology.royalty_expectation: 5–10% on services revenue; per-asset per-month for SaaS
technology.upfront_cost: ₹20L–₹1 Cr depending on geography / industry exclusivity
technology.certification_status: ISO 9001; explosion-proof for refinery environments; intrinsic safety where required
